title: Aligning Judge Models to Be Logically Consistent Multi-Rule Interpreters
abstract: arXiv:2611.29975v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Technical governance of AI models will soon require them to reason over and follow thousands of rules from different jurisdictions. However, as we show in this work, presenting an entire ruleset to a judge model---rather than asking it to judge one rule at a time---changes the way the model interprets the requirements, making it reach conclusions that conflict with its rule-by-rule judgments. We call this challenge multi-rule inconsistency and find that models are more lenient when judging rules embedded within the full ruleset than when judging rules separately. For example, we find that when a safety-critical rule prohibiting a model from pursuing objectives other than those it was given appears in a larger ruleset, all tested judge models are less likely to deem it violated. We examine several methods for reducing inconsistency, including prompting, consistency training using GRPO, and iterative rule refinement. As in human statutory

translated_title: 对齐裁判模型使其成为逻辑一致的多规则解释器
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.29975v1 公告类型：new 摘要：对AI模型的技术治理将很快要求它们对来自不同司法管辖区的数千条规则进行推理并遵循。然而，正如我们在本工作中所展示的，向裁判模型呈现完整的规则集——而非要求它一次只判断一条规则——会改变模型解释规则要求的方式，使其得出与逐条规则判断相冲突的结论。我们将这一挑战称为“多规则不一致性”，并发现模型在判断嵌入完整规则集中的规则时，比单独判断规则时更为宽松。例如，我们发现当一条禁止模型追求给定目标之外其他目标的安全关键规则出现在更大的规则集中时，所有受测的裁判模型都不太可能判定该规则被违反。我们研究了几种减少不一致性的方法，包括提示工程、使用GRPO进行一致性训练以及迭代式规则细化。正如人类成文法……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文发现了“多规则不一致性”问题——裁判模型在完整规则集中判断规则比逐条单独判断时更宽松（尤其是安全关键规则更易被放行），并提出了提示工程、基于GRPO的一致性训练和迭代规则细化等方法，将裁判模型对齐为逻辑一致的多规则解释器。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies "multi-rule inconsistency"—judge models judge rules more leniently when embedded in full rulesets than when judged individually, especially for safety-critical rules—and proposes methods including prompting, GRPO-based consistency training, and iterative rule refinement to align judge models as logically consistent multi-rule interpreters.
